description: Uploads local photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC; up to 20 MB each) into a showcase, straight to storage. Use it to turn a folder of project photos into a client-editable gallery: pass files, folders (recursive by default), and globs via paths, and per-photo alt text and categories via files. Skips hidden files and validates file contents. Run with dryRun: true first and show the result to the user; Only call after showing the plan to the user and getting explicit confirmation. Resumable: re-running with the same arguments skips files already uploaded (and still applies changed alt text and categories). categoryFromFolder tags each photo with its top-level folder's name; categories tags every photo (both created if missing). In a projects showcase, pass project: the photos join the end of that project (categories belong to the project there, not to photos); the same file can go into several projects. Returns files: each local path with its showcase item id and status, for update_items and tag_items. Alt text: Write concise, descriptive alt text: what the photo shows (e.g. "Cedar deck with glass railing at dusk"), without "image of" or "photo of". Leave it empty for purely decorative photos.

categories.description: Category names to tag every uploaded photo with, e.g. ["Featured"].

categoryFromFolder.description: Tag photos with their top-level folder name as a category (default false), e.g. true for Kitchens/ and Decks/ folders.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the user's project folder; relative paths resolve against it, e.g. "/Users/ana/sites/acme".

dryRun.description: Only check the files and report what would be uploaded, e.g. true for the first call.

files.description: Photos with their own alt text and categories, e.g. [{ "path": "/abs/photos/deck.jpg", "alt": "Cedar deck at dusk", "categories": ["Decks"] }].

alt.description: Alt text, up to 500 characters, e.g. "Cedar deck with glass railing at dusk". Empty or null for a purely decorative photo; omit to leave it unchanged.

categories.description: Categories for this photo (created if missing), e.g. ["Decks"].

path.description: A photo file (or a folder/glob, applying the same alt text and categories to each), e.g. "/abs/photos/deck.jpg".

paths.description: Files, folders, or glob patterns, e.g. ["/abs/photos/**/*.jpg"]. Prefer absolute paths; relative ones resolve against cwd. Pass paths, files, or both.

project.description: Projects showcases only, and required there: the project (slug, title, or id from list_projects or create_project) the photos join, e.g. "arched-entry-two-story".

recursive.description: Include subfolders (default true), e.g. false to upload only the top folder.

showcaseId.description: Showcase id from create_showcase or list_showcases, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

name: upload_photos
title: Upload photos
